cards.name: The-O
cards.effect:
<Suppression> (Damage to Shields by an attack is dealt to the first 2 cards simultaneously.)
Each enemy player's rested Units with the lowest Lv. won't be set as active during the start phase of their turn.

faqs.q: If I use this second effect when there are two Units that are Lv.3 and one Unit that is Lv.5 on my opponent's field, the two Units that are Lv.3 won't be set as active during the start phase of their turn, right?
faqs.a: Yes. If there are multiple Units with the lowest Lv., none of them will be set as active during the start phase of the opponent's turn.

faqs.q: Do Units affected by this second effect get set as active by the 【Main】 effect on GD01-121 Midair Modifications after that card's 【Burst】 effect activates it?
faqs.a: Yes, they are set as active. During the specified turn's start phase is the only time when they won't be set as active. Setting them as active in a different phase with an effect is valid.

faqs.q: If I use this second effect in a multiplayer battle, the rested Units with the lowest Lv. on each opponent's field won't be set as active during the start phase of that player's turn, right?

cards.name: Full Armor Unicorn Gundam (Destroy Mode)
cards.effect:
【Deploy】Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. You may reveal a number of cards equal to the number of enemy players among them and add them to your hand. Return the remaining cards randomly to the bottom of your deck.
【During Pair】【Once per Turn】When this Unit would receive battle damage from an enemy Unit with AP equal to or less than it, it doesn't receive that damage.

faqs.q: Can I choose not to activate this 【Deploy】 ability?
faqs.a: No. You are forced to activate this effect up to and including the portion "Look at the top 3 cards of your deck." Whether or not you add eligible cards among them to your hand is your choice.

■Choose 1 to 2 enemy Units with 3 or less HP. Rest them.
